title: DACI Matrix
description: Schema for a governance DACI matrix mapping decision types to Driver/Approver/Contributors/Informed roles. Alternative to RACI (see raci-matrix.schema.json) for clients whose decisions are more initiative/approval-shaped than ongoing operational work.

domain.description: Domain or council this DACI matrix applies to.

driver.description: Single role who owns driving the decision to a recommendation. Must be exactly one.

approver.description: Single role with final sign-off authority. Must be exactly one.

contributors.description: Role(s) whose input shapes the recommendation.
